title: Agent Safety Kit findings
description: Machine-readable HITL and safety-gate decisions from agent-safety-kit. Record a category and a location in evidence; keep secret values, tokens, and key material out of the document. status uses a small triage vocabulary (confirmed, needs_review, dismissed) so a later adapter can place these records beside an audit-style findings report. This schema stands alone and does not follow a vendor audit format.

schema_version.description: Revision of this document shape. Current documents use "1".

findings.description: One record per gate decision or scrub hit.

id.description: Stable id, unique within this document.

skill.description: Kit skill that raised the finding.

severity.description: info: note and continue. warn: review before the next risky step. block: do not perform the action.

status.description: confirmed: a person or the gate already decided. needs_review: waiting on a person. dismissed: closed with no further action.

recommendation.description: What the agent should do next. Name the action; omit secret values.

evidence.description: Why the finding exists. Name the category and location. Omit secret values.

summary.description: One or two sentences a reviewer can scan.

location.description: Path, git ref, host, or field.

category.description: Action class or secret category label, such as delete or github-token.
